How This Calculator Works

1. Monthly Payment Calculation
NAF = Finance Amount + All Financed Fees
Commission = NAF × Commission Rate
Total Financed = NAF + Commission
Monthly Rate = Annual Rate ÷ 12
PMT (Arrears) = Total Financed × [r(1+r)^n] ÷ [(1+r)^n - 1]
PMT (Advance) = PMT Arrears ÷ (1 + Monthly Rate)

With balloon: Reduce principal by present value of balloon before calculating PMT.

2. Comparison Rate Calculation
Comparison Rate = The annual rate that, applied to NAF alone, would produce the same monthly payment
We solve: PMT(NAF, comparison_rate, term, balloon) = Calculated Payment

The comparison rate is always higher than the base rate because it accounts for the capitalised commission. This shows the customer the "true cost" of the loan.

3. Why Comparison Rate Matters
Base Rate: 8.50% → Applied to Total Financed (NAF + Commission)
Comparison Rate: 9.23% → Equivalent rate if applied to NAF only

The difference reflects the cost of capitalising the broker's commission into the loan.
